operation.name: InsertGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP
operation.query: SET @ReturnValue = 0; INSERT INTO [GBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP] ([GBVID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@GBVID ,@Filename ,@FileAttached ,@ContentType ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,0); SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

operation.name: DeleteGBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP
operation.query: IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVAttachmentID FROM GBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP WHERE DELETED = 0 AND GBVAttachmentID = @GBVAttachmentID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [GBVAttachmentDedicated_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE GBVAttachmentID = @GBVAttachmentID SET @ReturnValue = 1; END
